VR.title: Quest's Horizon+ Subscription Added 10 Monthly Hours Of Xbox Games
VR.summary: Meta's Horizon+ subscription now offers 10 monthly hours of Xbox cloud gaming, enhancing its partnership with Microsoft for Quest users.

VR.title: Immersed Says It’s Finally Getting Ready to Ship ‘Visor’ VR Headset
VR.summary: Immersed is nearing the launch of its Visor VR headset, promising a work-focused standalone experience for users.

VR.title: Mixed Reality Tower Defense Game Cybercore Protocol Out Now In Early Access On Quest
VR.summary: Cybercore Protocol, a mixed reality tower defense game, has launched in Early Access on Quest, inviting players to experience its unique gameplay.

VR.title: Roboquest VR Launches Today On Quest 3 Along With Cross-Platform Co-Op
VR.summary: Roboquest VR has officially launched on Meta Quest 3, featuring cross-platform co-op play with SteamVR and PSVR 2.

VR.title: A.R. Rahman Brings His Immersive Music Experiences To Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: A.R. Rahman has launched ARR Immersive for Apple Vision Pro, delivering original immersive music experiences in 360 and 180-degree formats.

VR.title: Futuristic VR FPS Hyper Dash Shutting Down This November
VR.summary: Triangle Factory announced the shutdown of its futuristic FPS Hyper Dash, set to close this November.

AI.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
AI.summary: Anthropic has released its latest AI model, Claude Opus 5, which approaches the capabilities of its predecessor, Claude Fable 5.

AI.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
AI.summary: Microsoft has unveiled new AI security tools that claim to outperform competitors while being more cost-effective.

AI.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
AI.summary: China's Moonshot AI has introduced the Kimi K3 model, intensifying competition by offering advanced capabilities at a lower cost than U.S. counterparts.

AI.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
AI.summary: Nvidia and Microsoft have formed an Open Secure AI Alliance to develop open-source AI security tools, excluding major players like OpenAI.

AI.title: AI’s finally expensive enough to make Wall Street nervous
AI.summary: Google's increased spending estimates have raised concerns on Wall Street, reflecting the growing costs associated with AI development.

AI.title: AI leaders sign statement asking the government to do something about automated AI
AI.summary: Leaders from top AI labs have urged the U.S. government to implement coordinated governance to manage the rapid advancement of AI technologies.

NFL.title: Vikings sign Brian O'Neill to four-year contract extension
NFL.summary: The Vikings have signed right tackle Brian O'Neill to a four-year contract extension, solidifying their offensive line.

NFL.title: Jalen Carter, Eagles agree to four-year extension
NFL.summary: Jalen Carter has agreed to a four-year extension with the Eagles, making him the highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history.

NFL.title: Klint Kubiak: Kirk Cousins is the starting QB, Fernando Mendoza and Aidan O'Connell should push him
NFL.summary: The Raiders have signed Kirk Cousins as their starting quarterback, setting the stage for training camp competition.

NFL.title: Chris Olave, Jordyn Tyson good to go at Saints camp
NFL.summary: Saints wide receiver Chris Olave has been cleared for full participation at training camp after offseason restrictions.

NFL.title: Reports: Packers sign K Lenny Krieg, cut K Lucas Havrisik
NFL.summary: The Packers have signed kicker Lenny Krieg while releasing Lucas Havrisik, continuing their search for stability in the kicking game.

NFL.title: Christian Gonzalez: I'd like to keep contract negotiations private
NFL.summary: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez prefers to keep his contract negotiations private, differing from owner Robert Kraft's public approach.
